description: This file defines a base interface for response signals related to namespace commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes an inner class specifying JSON field definitions for namespace responses.

classes.name: NamespaceCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface for all response signals related to NamespaceCommand, extending CommandResponse and WithNamespace.

classes.name: NamespaceCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: An abstract static inner class containing JSON field definitions used in NamespaceCommandResponse, specifically for namespace and resource type fields.

methods.name: NamespaceCommandResponse.JsonFields.NAMESPACE
methods.description: A static final definition for the 'namespace' JSON field.

methods.name: NamespaceCommandResponse.JsonFields.RESOURCE_TYPE
methods.description: A static final definition for the 'resourceType' JSON field.
